name: Ramaya Ramabhadraya
text:
रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे ।
रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Rama, the noble and auspicious, Ramachandra, the creator, lord of the Raghus, the protector, husband of Sita.
purpose: Salutations to Rama in his noble and auspicious forms.
when: In a Rama or Hanuman practice.
